svg.title: SD11 — Move to an Adjacent Location through a Locked Door (UC06, F06; Command, Observer)

g.text: SD11 — Move to an Adjacent Location through a Locked Door (UC06, F06; Command, Observer)
a typed "go east" arrives through SD02 with target "east"
SD03 — mode check: allows(MOVE) is false in combat and dialogue
the command keeps door and key
in its exit and key fields for execute()
invalid if door is null (no exit that way, or the
destination is not adjacent: the exits are listed),
or the door is locked and key is null ("You need the shed key.")
SD03 — the MOVEMENT event is published (SD05):
SwingGameView.onEvent() calls refresh(), which redraws the map
text = the results' messages, e.g. the shed's
description, items, NPCs and exits (no LLM)
